contexts.text: In the Third State, from the internal man he speaks piously and devoutly... called the tender herb, also the herb of seed ().
The Lord causes him to bear some tender thing, which is called the tender herb; then something more useful, which again becomes prolific, and is called the herb seeding seed.
While man supposes that he does good from himself, his truths... are called the tender herb, and also the herb seeding seed.
Spiritual meats (not celestial) are signified by the herb seeding seed.
The herb seeding seed = all truth which regards use.
That spiritual meat is called herb, is said in, My Shepherd, I shall not want. Thou makest me to lie down in pastures of herb.

To the Natural is given for meat the vegetable and the green of the herb (). Both his natural and spiritual food are thus described, Jehovah causeth grass to glow for the beast, and herb for the ministry of man... ().

At the time of combat, the evil Spirits... leave no food for the man except what is compared to the vegetable, and the green of the herb. But the Lord gives him food in addition, which is compared to the herb seeding seed.
The Scientific and Rational of the celestial man are described by the shrub, and the herb out of the ground watered with vapour (). AC 90, AC 91.
To eat the herb of the field, or wild food () = to live as wild animals. Illustrated.
They are called the vegetable of the herb () because they are only worldly and bodily things...
Grass, or herb = scientifics...
Each herb in the Word = some special thing of what is scientific; as the flag... a low Scientific...
The herb of every field () = every scientific truth of the Church. ( = every truth of the Church. AC 8902:6.)
All herbaceous things (as grass) = nothing else (than the lowest Scientific).

Upon every herb of the field in the land of Egypt () = every truth of the Church in the natural mind. Herb = truth... because land and field = the Church... By the herb of the field is meant everything in general which is produced from a field. Illustrated.
The herb () = the produce of the field. That by herb, here, is signified the truth of the Church, and by the tares falsity, is evident...
Pastures of herb = spiritual nourishment...
In these passages... herb of the land, and herb of the field = the truth of faith.
The hail smote every herb of the field () = that these falsities destroyed every truth of the Church.
It shall devour every herb of the land () = the total consumption of all truth... The herb of the land = the truth of the Church.

It shall devour every herb of the land () = that all the Scientific of truth would be destroyed... The herb of the field = the truth of the Church, because field = the Church; but the herb of the land = the Scientific of truth, because land, here, = the natural mind...
In the tree, and in the herb of the field () = from the Cognitive and the Scientific of the Church... The herb of the field = the Scientific of truth.
To eat herb () = to appropriate it only scientifically. Herb = the Scientific.
The like is signified by the herb of the field. Illustrated.
Drops upon the herb () = natural truth.
The herb of every field = all the truth and good of the Church.
Pastures of herb = Knowledges of truth and good.
The habitations of the wilderness have become herbaged () = Knowledges of truth where there were none before. Herbaged = the growth and multiplication of them. AE 650:40.
Herb = nascent truths from good.
No herb = no truth in the Church.
Grass = scientific truth; and herb of the field, spiritual truths; for the herb of the field means the corn first born in the field; therefore it is said, herb for the ministry of man.
I will dry up all their herb () = that the truths from these goods will perish.
The herb of the field = the truth there.
To give herb in the field () = the Knowledge of truth and good from the Word, and the derivative intelligence.
Grass = the truth of the natural man, which is scientific truth... Herb = the truth of the spiritual man.
Herb of the field = the truth of the Church born and nascent. AE 653:end.
Herb of the land = truths from good.
Herb germinating = truth such as it is when first received.
